name: viralclip
description: ViralClip - automated short-form video clipping for Golpo Box Facebook Reels

scripts.build: npm run build -w @viralclip/shared && npm run build -w @viralclip/prompts && npm run build -w @viralclip/providers && npm run build -w @viralclip/video && npm run build -w @viralclip/database && npm run build -w @viralclip/worker && npm run build -w @viralclip/api
scripts.test: npm run build && vitest run --config tests/vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && vitest run --config tests/vitest.unit.config.ts
scripts.test:video: npm run build && vitest run --config tests/vitest.video.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && vitest run --config tests/vitest.e2e.config.ts
